newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Wind River as accumulate.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Wind River as accumulate.

text.p: -- DMG analyst Michael Kwatinetz said in a research note he was reiterating his "accumulate" rating on Wind River Systems, projecting top-line growth in the 30 percent range through the year 2000.
-- Shares up 5 to 48-1/8 after rising as high as 50.
-- Company earlier said its board had authorized a three-for-two stock split.
-- Analyst forecasts the 32/64-bit run-time operating systems (RTOS) and tools market -- in which Wind River competes -- will grow in the 20-25 percent range through the year 2000.
